3._section_summary: This section describes the data analysis procedures used in the study, including descriptive statistics and Pearson correlation analyses conducted using IBM SPSS 22.0 and Amos 22.0. A path analysis model was tested to examine direct and indirect effects among variables, with body appreciation measured using the BAS-2 scale, while controlling for body mass index. The study employed Maximum Likelihood estimation with 95% confidence intervals and examined multiple model fit indices (Chi-Square, TLI, CFI, RMSEA) to assess model adequacy.
